hermoso.description: Hermoso: AI marketing agent and AI ad generator for your AI agent. No markup on models. Research the ads and posts competitors are running, make on-brand image and video ads, schedule posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X, LinkedIn and more, and build paid campaigns on Meta, Google, TikTok and other ad platforms (created paused). Hosted server, OAuth 2.1 sign-in.
